about_the_game:
SET IN THE LANDS OF VIRGINIA, EARLY 2000s. CRIME IS RAMPANT EVERYWHERE..

Embark on a great journey where you have no one other than yourself to trust. And i mean it.

Reckless sets the mark for what indie open world games can be.

Developed using Unreal Engine 5, powered by Lumen & More amazing features and technology brought by the engine.

  • Singleplayer Only, but with enough content to keep you playing for hours!

  • Great performance despite the engine being so new!

  • You have one personal vehicle where you can use it to drive around the map.

  • Immersive shooting system and parkour, as well as movement mechanics!

In Reckless, you are sent to an island in West Virginia.. far from where you came.

You realize you are stuck there, so you have to learn things on your own..

Note: The game will have updates post launch, including multiplayer, more things to do and explore, and a lot more! The base game is finished and shipped as-is but with the help of the community, you can help improve the game!

  • Memory: 2 GB RAM

short_description: Reckless is an open world game set in a fictional island in West Virginia, United States. 2000s. You play as a person who was kidnapped and sent to the island, with no way of returning home.. so.. this is your new life. Make the most of it!
